title: kinema_catalog index
description: catalog.json: every robot description in the catalog. Built by `meshkit index` from catalog/*.yaml; do not edit it by hand.

id.description: Short name, unique across the catalog; what the launcher takes on its command line.

family.description: A maker's range: the catalog/<family>.yaml the entry comes from, and the release zip it ships in.

licence.description: SPDX expression; LicenseRef-* for terms SPDX does not list.

licence_note.description: What the licence restricts, where it restricts anything.

submodule.description: Directory under src/: the fork that holds the description, cloned on demand.

entry.description: The file to open, relative to the repository root. Usually inside the submodule; a wrapper kept in this repository otherwise.

mesh_base.description: For a URDF that names its meshes by relative path: the directory, relative to the repository root, that they resolve against. null when meshes use package://.
